meninges: protective membranes around the brain and spinal cord
cerebellum: back part of the brain that controls balance
brainstem: base of the brain connecting to the spinal cord
hypothalamus: brain area that controls hormones and body temperature
pituitary gland: small gland at the base of the brain that controls hormones
adrenal glands: small glands above the kidneys that make stress hormones
thyroid gland: butterfly-shaped gland in the neck that controls metabolism
parathyroid glands: tiny glands behind the thyroid that control calcium
pancreas: gland behind the stomach that makes insulin and digestive juices
spleen: organ in the upper left belly that filters blood
appendix: small pouch attached to the large intestine
duodenum: first part of the small intestine
jejunum: middle part of the small intestine
ileum: last part of the small intestine
cecum: pouch at the start of the large intestine
sigmoid colon: lower S-shaped part of the large intestine
rectum: final section of the large intestine
ureter: tube carrying urine from the kidney to the bladder
urethra: tube carrying urine out of the body
renal pelvis: funnel-shaped area inside the kidney that collects urine
glomerulus: tiny filtering unit in the kidney
fallopian tube: tube carrying eggs from the ovary to the uterus
epididymis: coiled tube at the back of each testicle
prostate gland: gland below the bladder in men that makes part of semen
seminal vesicles: glands that make fluid for semen
carotid artery: main artery in the neck supplying blood to the brain
aorta: main artery carrying blood from the heart to the body
inferior vena cava: large vein returning blood to the heart from the lower body
superior vena cava: large vein returning blood to the heart from the upper body
portal vein: vein carrying blood from the gut to the liver
hepatic vein: vein draining blood from the liver
renal vein: vein draining blood from the kidney
saphenous vein: vein running along the inside of the leg
brachial plexus: network of nerves supplying the arm
sciatic nerve: large nerve running down the back of the leg
femoral nerve: nerve supplying the front of the thigh
diaphragm: dome-shaped muscle separating the chest from the belly
rotator cuff: group of muscles and tendons stabilising the shoulder
achilles tendon: tendon connecting the calf muscles to the heel bone
synovium: lining of the joint that makes lubricating fluid
periosteum: tough covering on the outside of bones
bone marrow: soft tissue inside bones that makes blood cells
